entry.label: Leverage points
entry.description: Leverage points are places where changing a system's information, feedback, rules, goals, structure or paradigms may alter its behaviour; their effect depends on direction, context and resistance.
aliases: places to intervene in a system
entry.canonical_definition: Leverage points are places where changing a system's information, feedback, rules, goals, structure or paradigms may alter its behaviour; their effect depends on direction, context and resistance.

profile.title: Leverage points
profile.canonical_definition: Leverage points are places where changing a system's information, feedback, rules, goals, structure or paradigms may alter its behaviour; their effect depends on direction, context and resistance.
profile.summary: Leverage points are intervention locations in a system's structure, information, feedback, rules, goals and paradigms.
profile.why_it_matters: They direct attention away from the visibility of an intervention towards the system property it changes and the direction in which it changes it.
common_misreadings: a leverage point is automatically beneficial
the highest level is always the correct target
open_checks: compare with intervention points in other traditions
profile.editorial_note: Developed from public primary, institutional and publisher sources. Open to correction, rival interpretation and stronger evidence.
